description: Canonical candidate derived from v0.5-2026-08-25: Reusable extraction schema for Australian travel insurance PDSs supporting comparison across insurers and plan tiers. Designed to emit one product record per distinct plan/variant described in a PDS. Tables are first-class evidence sources.

review.rationale:
Approved as a pilot hybrid Canonical Schema after reviewing product identity,
field types and PostgreSQL mappings. Stable identity and comparison fields use
core or extension columns. Evolving long-tail insurance attributes remain in
JSONB pending broader cross-insurer validation. Required nullable fields mean
the key must be present while unknown values may remain null.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: The marketing product/series name on the PDS (e.g., International Comprehensive; International Plans).

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Classifier indicating the plan’s core product category derived from geographic scope and trip frequency. Use international_single_trip for one-off international trips; international_multi_trip for annual multi-trip; domestic for Australia-only trip cover; inbound for non-residents travelling to/within Australia; business when a distinct business pack/plan is marketed; cruise when a distinct cruise-only plan is marketed (not just an optional add-on).

fields.name: insurer_name
fields.description: Insurer legal entity name on the PDS (issuer/underwriter).

fields.name: insurer_licence_ids
fields.description: Issuer identifiers and licensing: ABN, AFSL, company number as printed.

fields.name: brand_or_trading_name
fields.description: Trading/brand name used to market the policy (e.g., Southern Cross Travel Insurance, Cover-More).

fields.name: plan_tier
fields.description: Plan or tier label as sold (e.g., Basic, Comprehensive, Comprehensive+).

fields.name: pds_title
fields.description: Exact PDS document title as printed.

fields.name: pds_effective_date
fields.description: PDS effective or issue date printed on the document.

fields.name: document_source_id
fields.description: Source document locator (file path, URL, hash) used during extraction.

fields.name: trip_frequency
fields.description: Trip frequency classification as marketed.

fields.name: annual_multi_trip_max_duration_days
fields.description: Maximum journey duration allowed per trip for Annual Multi‑Trip (days).

fields.name: area_of_travel_options
fields.description: Geographic scope/areas of travel selection options as described (e.g., Worldwide, All of Europe, All of Asia, Australia).

fields.name: cruise_add_on_required
fields.description: Whether cruise-related claims require purchasing an add-on. true if multi-night cruise cover is an optional add-on that must be selected and paid for to enable cruise-related benefits.

fields.name: eligibility_summary
fields.description: Eligibility and residency criteria summary (e.g., live in Australia permanently; Medicare eligible; return to Australia; inbound non-resident conditions).

fields.name: age_limits
fields.description: Minimum and maximum age or age rules for cover and any age-banded benefits (e.g., personal accident payable ages 16–80).

fields.name: dependent_children_policy
fields.description: Dependent children covered without extra premium; qualifying criteria.

fields.name: pre_existing_medical_cover
fields.description: Pre-existing medical conditions: whether automatic conditions are included, assessment required, exclusions for undiagnosed symptoms, pregnancy weeks covered and restrictions.

fields.name: excess_options_aud
fields.description: Excess options a customer can select (AUD). Include notes on when excess applies once per event and any zero-excess option if stated.

fields.name: special_excesses
fields.description: Special excesses that override the standard excess (e.g., COVID-19 special excess by section). Represent as objects: {section, amount_aud, when_applies}.

fields.name: cancellation_cover_limit
fields.description: Cancellation cover amount. For products where the customer chooses an amount, store 'selected_amount' with any min/max/steps; otherwise store the fixed/maximum limit.

fields.name: overseas_medical_limit
fields.description: Overseas medical cover headline limit (e.g., Unlimited). Include time caps if stated (e.g., up to 12 months from onset).

fields.name: emergency_dental_limit_aud
fields.description: Emergency dental limit per person.

fields.name: baggage_limit_aud
fields.description: Baggage/personal effects overall limit per person.

fields.name: baggage_sublimits
fields.description: Baggage common sub-limits (e.g., phones, cameras, laptops, jewellery). Represent as objects: {item_category, per_item_limit_aud, aggregate_cap_aud_if_any}.

fields.name: specified_items_rules
fields.description: Whether customers can increase item limits or specify items and the total/ per-item caps for specified items.

fields.name: rental_vehicle_excess_limit_aud
fields.description: Rental vehicle insurance excess benefit limit per person.

fields.name: rental_vehicle_comprehensive_cover
fields.description: Whether a comprehensive rental vehicle cover extension is included (beyond excess) and any key caps (e.g., CDW for USA/Canada, vehicle value limits).

fields.name: personal_liability_limit_aud
fields.description: Personal liability maximum cover per person.

fields.name: personal_accident_benefits
fields.description: Personal accident benefits: include components such as loss_of_income (weekly cap, max weeks), total_permanent_disablement, accidental_death. Represent as objects with fields {component, amount_aud, per_week_aud_if_applicable, max_weeks, age_applicability}.

fields.name: covid19_cover_summary
fields.description: COVID-19 coverage summary: which sections are covered (medical, cancellation before/after departure, additional expenses), notable sub-limits and compulsory special excesses.

fields.name: waiting_periods
fields.description: Key waiting periods or deferrals (e.g., loss of income waiting days; already travelling 3-day no-cover period if applicable).

fields.name: general_exclusions_summary
fields.description: General exclusions headline list or section references (e.g., terrorism limits, travel advisories, private treatment, activities).

fields.name: optional_add_ons
fields.description: Optional add-ons available for the plan (e.g., cruise cover, skiing/snowboarding, motorcycle/moped, adventure activities packs, business pack, cancellation plus, specified items).

fields.name: emergency_assistance_details
fields.description: 24/7 emergency assistance contact details and any triage/approval thresholds (e.g., call if admitted, surgery, or costs over $2,000).

fields.name: claim_requirements
fields.description: Claim reporting requirements (e.g., report theft to police within 7 days, PIR required, provide receipts, lodge within 60 days).

fields.name: benefits
fields.description: Consolidated benefit entries normalised across insurers. Each object should include {category (use coverage_categories.canonical_name), benefit_name, limit_per_person, limit_per_policy, sub_limits[], per_day_amount_if_any, excess_applicable (yes/no/notes), conditions, page_or_table_ref}.

fields.name: source_evidence
fields.description: Structured evidence links used for extraction. Each object should include {field_name, source_type (text/table), page, table_id, evidence_excerpt}.
